component.title: Async Panel
component.purpose: Present a meaningful region's loading, ready, empty, partial, or error state while preserving the ExperienceSurface lifecycle contract.

states.description: The panel announces that content is loading.
The panel renders usable primary content.
The panel completed successfully without applicable content.
The panel is usable while explaining unavailable supporting information.
The panel announces a terminal error and can provide retry.

claims.statement: Every panel state is exposed through the embedded ExperienceSurface lifecycle attributes.
Loading, partial, and error states provide a polite status announcement.
